title: Page registry
description: Every user-facing page of হিসাব খাতা (data/registry/tools.json). Routes, menus, search, the sitemap and the app router all read this list, so a page exists in one place only.

groups.description: The tool groups of the 'সব টুল' page (Figma A1), in display order.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. Never rename one: saved items, share links and analytics keep it.

kind.description: tool = calculator, converter or text tool; hub = a page that lists other pages; guide = government or how-to guide (and the guide wizard); mfs / bank / remittance = provider pages and comparisons; static = about, privacy and the like; system = home, search, all tools, saved, 404, offline.

section.description: 'root', or the id of the hub this page sits under (the breadcrumb parent).

priority.description: launch = in the first release; later = listed in Figma as 'শীঘ্রই' or not yet designed.

route.description: ASCII paths. English is the Bangla path under /en. A [param] segment is filled from data (e.g. [bank] from data/banks.json).

name.description: The page title (H1). Bangla is the Figma text.

shortName.description: Label for list rows, chips and tabs, where Figma shows a shorter one.

description.description: The line under the title; also the meta description.

breadcrumb.description: Labels after 'হোম' exactly as the Figma frame shows them. The first label links to the section hub.

keywords.description: Search terms in Bangla, Banglish and English, including common misspellings (bikash, bkas).

engine.description: The packages/core/src module that does the sums, or null.

dataFiles.description: Files under data/ the page reads (planned files may not exist yet).

figma.description: Figma frames that draw this page (base, dark, modes, states). Overlays drawn over it are in design/figma-map.json.

items.description: Hubs only: the pages the hub lists, in Figma order.

draftCopy.description: true when the Bangla name or description is not verbatim from Figma and needs an editor's check.
